ngos.subject: Early-stage open-source AI research – contact question for Oxfam GB
ngos.body:
Dear colleagues,

I am writing to Oxfam GB with a short question.

I am Ruslan Gagiev (Velan), a product manager in Hamburg. We are researching a multi-level, multi-step reasoning system for cross-domain problems ordinary AI agents handle poorly, too much for one person to hold in mind. People read its reports and give suggestions. This is real research under way now, not science fiction, and not everything works yet. For your work, we hope it could eventually help with water, nutrition and housing. It is an early-stage prototype: no users, no external audit, no clinical validation, nothing deployed. Built so far: Titan, an open-source (MIT) memory and audit prototype with a verifiable hash chain (github.com/velantrian/Velantrim-ExoCortex-Titan). The aim is benefit for people, not only profit.

Could you tell me who in your organisation handles research or digital partnerships?

Drafted with AI assistance and reviewed by me; most code is written by AI assistants I direct.

Kind regards,
Ruslan Gagiev (Velan)
velantrim@gmail.com
